sources.snippet: The result is a model that finally speaks clearly, follows instructions, and remembers context - because it's no longer fighting its own internal chaos. What is Genesis? Genesis is post training data regeneration and calibrarion algorythm for neural networks (LLM) in GGUF format that I made with AI help during almost half a year of development.
